title: Operator System Card
paper_type_zh: 前沿模型系统卡与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 需要审计闭源计算机使用智能体报告中已披露与未披露的后训练数据、反馈和复现边界的读者
one_line: OpenAI's Operator System Card reports specialized supervised computer-use data, broad public-data sources, and reinforcement learning for a GPT-4o-based CUA, but leaves task records, rewards/verifiers, training environments, and lineage undisclosed.
OpenAI 的《Operator System Card》披露：基于 GPT-4o 的 CUA 使用专门的计算机操作监督数据、广义公开数据来源和强化学习；任务记录、奖励/验证器、训练环境及数据谱系均未披露。
why: It is a clear Track 12 boundary case: the report makes the existence and broad role of computer-use demonstrations and reinforcement learning auditable, yet does not provide enough data, feedback, or environment detail to reconstruct or safely reuse the recipe.
inclusion_reason: An official frontier system card that explicitly distinguishes specialized supervised computer-use data and reinforcement learning, while withholding the task trajectories, reward contract, environments, and data lineage needed to reproduce the post-training pipeline.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Operator is a January 2025 research preview of OpenAI's Computer-Using Agent (CUA): a GPT-4o-based model that operates graphical interfaces by observing screens and using cursor and keyboard actions. The official report explains that the capability was developed with specialized supervised computer-use data and reinforcement learning, but it does not expose a reusable post-training dataset or recipe.

For a frontier-report ledger, the key problem is therefore evidentiary rather than performance-related: which parts of the data and feedback pipeline are actually disclosed? This Card separates the report's explicit claims from unreported task records, rewards, environments, and lineage. It does not treat the reported safety evaluations or red-teaming as training data.

Operator 是 OpenAI 于 2025 年 1 月发布的 Computer-Using Agent（CUA）研究预览：该模型以 GPT-4o 为基础，通过观察屏幕并使用光标和键盘操作图形界面。官方报告说明其能力依赖专门的计算机操作监督数据和强化学习，但未公开可复用的后训练数据集或配方。

因此，对前沿报告披露账本而言，核心问题不是性能，而是证据边界：数据与反馈流水线中哪些部分被真实披露？本 Card 将报告的明示主张与未披露的任务记录、奖励、环境和谱系分开；不会把已报告的安全评估或红队测试当作训练数据。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The report gives a high-level, two-stage account: supervised learning on specialized data teaches screen perception and input control, then reinforcement learning supplies higher-level reasoning, error correction, and adaptation to unexpected events. It also says the training mixture includes select public data—mostly industry-standard machine-learning datasets and web crawls—and human-trainer-developed datasets showing how to solve computer tasks.

That is a useful disclosure boundary, not a released data object. The report does not specify the individual task, observation, action, trace, reward, or terminal-outcome fields. Nor does it state the reinforcement-learning reward or verifier contract. Accordingly, this entry is a model_report for Track 12, with partial status and no claim of RLVR or of reusable agent trajectories.

报告给出了一个高层次的两阶段描述：在专门数据上的监督学习负责屏幕感知和输入控制；随后，强化学习提供更高层次的推理、纠错与应对意外事件的能力。报告还说明训练混合物包括选择性的公开数据（主要来自业界标准机器学习数据集和网页爬取）以及由人工训练师开发、演示如何完成计算机任务的数据集。

这是一条有价值的披露边界，而不是已发布的数据对象。报告没有说明单条任务、观察、动作、轨迹、奖励或终止结果字段，也没有说明强化学习的奖励或验证器契约。因此，本条目在 Track 12 中作为 model_report 收录，状态为 partial；不主张其属于 RLVR，也不主张其发布了可复用的智能体轨迹。

title: Method
方法
html:
The accepted sources identify GPT-4o as the base model and state that CUA combines supervised learning on specialized computer-use data with reinforcement learning. Human trainers developed datasets demonstrating computer tasks; the public-data portion is described only by broad source classes. The official CUA page describes the deployed interaction loop as screenshots/raw pixels in context plus virtual mouse and keyboard actions, but it does not establish that this is the stored schema of supervised examples or RL trajectories.

The report supplies no named training datasets, source mixture, task generator, trainer protocol, action encoding, filtering rule, sampling protocol, reward model, verifier, optimizer, rollout count, temperature, inference budget, terminal-success predicate, split, decontamination procedure, license, or replay metadata. The system card reports red-teaming and safety/capability evaluations, including some mock test environments; these are recorded as evaluation and risk-identification evidence only. The report does not say that they trained CUA.

已核验的来源将 GPT-4o 标为基础模型，并说明 CUA 把专门的计算机操作数据上的监督学习与强化学习结合起来。人工训练师开发了演示计算机任务的数据集；公开数据部分只以宽泛的来源类别描述。官方 CUA 页面把部署时的交互循环描述为：将屏幕截图/原始像素置入上下文，再执行虚拟鼠标和键盘动作；但这并不能证明它就是监督样本或 RL 轨迹的存储模式。

报告未提供训练数据集名称、来源配比、任务生成器、训练师规程、动作编码、过滤规则、采样规程、奖励模型、验证器、优化器、rollout 数量、温度、推理预算、成功终止条件、数据划分、去污染过程、许可证或回放元数据。系统卡报告了红队测试和安全/能力评估，其中包括部分模拟测试环境；本 Card 仅将它们记录为评估与风险识别证据。报告没有说明它们被用于训练 CUA。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The primary evidence is OpenAI's Operator System Card PDF, dated January 23, 2025. Its “Model data and training” section explicitly names the specialized supervised-data and reinforcement-learning stages, the broad public-data sources, and human-trainer computer-task demonstrations. Its risk-identification sections describe internal and external red teaming, including a warning that constrained mock environments may not capture worst-case real-world risks.

The official Operator System Card publication page confirms the report's purpose and date. The official Computer-Using Agent page describes the deployed screen-to-action loop and user-confirmation behavior. These sources support a report-level disclosure assessment; they do not provide a released dataset, code, reward/verifier artifact, or item-level lineage.

首要证据是 OpenAI 于 2025 年 1 月 23 日发布的 Operator System Card PDF。其“Model data and training”部分明确写出专门监督数据与强化学习阶段、宽泛的公开数据来源，以及由人工训练师开发的计算机任务演示数据。其风险识别部分描述了内部和外部红队测试，并提醒受约束的模拟环境可能无法覆盖最坏的真实世界风险。

官方 Operator System Card 发布页确认了报告的用途和日期；官方 Computer-Using Agent 页面描述了部署时从屏幕到动作的循环以及用户确认行为。这些来源支持报告层面的披露评估；它们没有提供已发布数据集、代码、奖励/验证器工件或条目级谱系。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
For this atlas, the contribution is not a newly released computer-use corpus. It is an official frontier disclosure that states both specialized supervised computer-use data and reinforcement learning, while also making the limits of that description visible. The report additionally ties the model report to deployment-specific safety work such as red teaming, confirmations, refusals, monitoring, and prompt-injection mitigation.

The distinction matters because the report's evaluation and mitigation discussions are richer than its training-data disclosure. The Card preserves that asymmetry instead of inferring an evaluation-derived reward, a reusable environment, or a complete agent-training recipe.

对本 atlas 而言，其贡献不是新发布了一个计算机操作语料库，而是一份官方前沿披露：它同时说明了专门的计算机操作监督数据和强化学习，也使这种说明的边界清晰可见。报告还将模型报告与部署特定的安全工作联系起来，例如红队测试、确认、拒答、监测和提示注入缓解措施。

这一差异很重要：报告对评估和缓解措施的讨论比对训练数据的披露更充分。本 Card 保留这种不对称性，不会推断出源自评估的奖励、可复用环境或完整的智能体训练配方。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
This report is not sufficient to reproduce or independently audit the post-training pipeline. Named sources, task inventories, mixture weights, record counts, sample schema, trainer instructions, data rights, splits, decontamination, environment versions, and trajectory replay details are all undisclosed. The reinforcement-learning objective, reward/verifier, calibration, rollout policy, optimizer, schedule, and terminal-success definition are likewise unknown.

The documented red-team and evaluation material should not be reclassified as model-training evidence. The report says external red teamers were advised to avoid prompting the model to complete tasks that could cause real-world harm and, in certain cases, created mock websites, databases, or emails; it notes that this constraint may not capture worst-case risk. Finally, this Card is scoped to the January 2025 GPT-4o-based Operator report, not the later o3 Operator update.

这份报告不足以复现或独立审计其后训练流水线。数据来源名称、任务清单、混合权重、记录数量、样本模式、训练师指引、数据权利、数据划分、去污染、环境版本和轨迹回放细节均未披露。强化学习的目标、奖励/验证器、校准、rollout 策略、优化器、日程以及成功终止定义同样未知。

已记录的红队和评估材料不应被重新归类为模型训练证据。报告称，外部红队被建议避免要求模型完成可能造成现实世界伤害的任务，并在某些情况下创建模拟网站、数据库或电子邮件；报告也指出，这一约束可能无法覆盖最坏风险。最后，本 Card 的范围仅限于 2025 年 1 月、基于 GPT-4o 的 Operator 报告，不涵盖后来的 o3 Operator 更新。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this Card as a conservative reference when comparing frontier agent reports. It supports a narrow but important claim: OpenAI publicly reports specialized computer-use supervision, broad source classes, and reinforcement learning for CUA. It does not support building a compatible dataset, reproducing an RL objective, treating benchmark or red-team records as reward data, or asserting that the system uses RL with verifiable rewards.

For post-training research, the Card separates three ledger columns that are often collapsed: disclosed training ingredients, disclosed evaluation and safety evidence, and unreported implementation details. It can guide audit requests for source manifests, demonstration schemas, reward contracts, environment pins, decontamination controls, and replay documentation. Until those artifacts are available, the Operator report should be used as a bounded disclosure record rather than a reusable agent-training recipe.

可将本 Card 用作比较前沿智能体报告时的保守参考。它支持一项狭义但重要的主张：OpenAI 公开报告了 CUA 的专门计算机操作监督、宽泛来源类别和强化学习。它不支持据此构建兼容数据集、复现 RL 目标、把基准或红队记录当作奖励数据，或断言系统使用了具有可验证奖励的 RL。

对后训练研究而言，本 Card 有助于区分常被混在一起的三列账本：已披露的训练成分、已披露的评估/安全证据，以及未披露的实现细节。它可用于提出审计请求：来源清单、演示样本模式、奖励契约、环境固定信息，以及去污染和回放文档。在这些工件公开之前，应把 Operator 报告作为一条有边界的披露记录，而不是可复用的智能体训练配方。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read §2 of the system card first: it is the evidence for specialized supervised computer-use data, broad source classes, and reinforcement learning.
  • Read the official CUA page as a deployment-interface description, not as a released trajectory schema.
  • When comparing safety evaluations or red teaming with training, keep the source's boundary explicit: the report does not say that evaluation or red-team records trained CUA.

• 先读 system card 的 §2：它是专门计算机操作监督数据、宽泛来源类别和强化学习的直接证据。
  • 将官方 CUA 页面作为部署接口描述阅读，而不是已发布的轨迹模式。
  • 比较安全评估或红队测试与训练时，必须保留来源的边界：报告没有说评估或红队记录训练了 CUA。
